header.purpose: Machine-readable unified ReadbackObservationEnvelope contract. The native ReadbackObservationEnvelope (Rust) reports ONLY what was observed; the Brain ReadbackObservationEnvelopeSchema validates the same fields and the deterministic evaluator decides whether the observation matches the expectation. Native observations must never carry verified / business_success / expected_match as authority.

cross_language.golden_vectors: docs/goal24/fixtures/cp8-outcome/readback-observation-vectors.json (35 vectors) - both suites validate, contract mismatch = 0

header.attempt_id_alias: verification_attempt_id is the canonical attempt binding id. native_attempt_id denotes the exact same value and namespace; the two names are interchangeable and MUST carry the same value (single-use, durably reserved before the read-back spawn).

observation_id.semantic: single-use observation identity; one observation can finalize exactly one attempt of one outcome

verification_attempt_id.producer: native reservation (rbattempt_ + 32 hex) or server-owned bridge id
verification_attempt_id.semantic: binds the observation to the in-flight attempt; alias native_attempt_id

verification_capability_id.producer: trusted binding identity registered in the compiled registry
verification_capability_id.semantic: binding 3/4: cross-capability observations are rejected; must equal the approved plan verification capability

subject_key.producer: derived by the trusted binding from the frozen verification_inputs (callers can never supply it)

attempt_started_at.producer: trusted native clock at the durable attempt reservation
attempt_started_at.semantic: freshness anchor: must be >= receipt.spawn_started_at and <= observed_at

observed_at.producer: trusted native clock when the payload was acquired; callers can never declare it
observed_at.semantic: must be >= attempt_started_at, >= receipt.accepted_at and within the clock-skew window

verification_source.producer: brain-bridge annotation (native emits neither; the trusted bridge sets native_readback; tests use synthetic_test)

verification_level.semantic: evidence-style level annotation; NEVER a semantic verdict authority

payload.type: JSON-safe plain object, <= 262144 bytes canonical JSON
payload.producer: trusted binding parser (strict JSON / marker-delimited JSON; never natural-language regex)
payload.semantic: the observed post-state; oversized or non-JSON-safe payloads are rejected before any evaluation

payload_digest.producer: native-computed; Brain recomputes and rejects on mismatch

truncated.producer: native (either output stream hit the broker cap)
truncated.semantic: truncated = true can NEVER verify (verification_failed / READBACK_TRUNCATED)

parser_status.producer: native emits parsed|malformed|truncated; unsupported is a Brain-visible binding status
parser_status.semantic: != parsed can NEVER verify: malformed -> READBACK_MALFORMED, unsupported -> READBACK_UNSUPPORTED, truncated -> READBACK_TRUNCATED

process_exit_code.semantic: process metadata only, never a verdict

process_timed_out.semantic: read-back process metadata; timed_out && cancelled together is structurally invalid

trust_rules: caller can only ever present an observation_id; the trusted observation resolver (TrustedObservationResolver) resolves it against the native trusted observation source
no public readback IPC, no REST observation import, no MCP 'mark verified' tool

verification inputs are immutable: read-back capability, inputs, subject, argv, executable, cwd, env all come from the approved ExecutionPlan.verification_plan frozen into the receipt; verification_plan_digest must match

verifier bindings must declare side_effect_class=read_only, risk_level=low, required_authority=L0; write / external-effect / elevated verifiers are rejected at registration (READBACK_BINDING_NOT_READ_ONLY)

expectations come only from the trusted OutcomeEvaluatorRegistry derived from the approved plan + normalized inputs + verification plan; callers can never supply expected_state / expected_result / success_condition / predicate / JSONPath / regex / comparison_prompt / judge_prompt
LLM Judge is FORBIDDEN in CP8 V1
each native read-back call performs exactly one attempt; no while-true retry; native hard maximum = 5 attempts per receipt (MAX_VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS); Brain default = 3
old observations can never be reused: freshness + identity binding + single-use observation ids defeat replay
